## Project 2 Interim Data Anaylsis Plan

1. For each aim, the hypotheses you will be testing, including a description of the outcome(s) and predictor(s) of interest

2. The over-all analysis approach you will be using for each hypothesis

3. How you will approach/incorporate the other data/variables available besides the outcomes and predictors of interest

4. What power/sample size calculations you will conduct for each of the hypotheses of interest

5. Not required for interim, but will be required for final: thoughts on your approach to type I error control.

### Aim 1
a) higher baseline cytokine and chemokine levels in circulating plasma will predict declines in memory consolidation and decreases in AD-signature cortical thickness

b) greater increases in cytokines and chemokines will be associated with greater declines in episodic memory and cortical thickness 

Predictors: 
a)
baseline cytokine levels
baseline chemokine levels
b)
change in cytokine
change in chemokine

Outcomes:

AD-signature cortical thickness
b)
episodic memory
cortical thickness

### Aim 2
We will test our hypothesis of an interaction between peripheral levels of inflammation and amyloid deposition,
such that the presence of both significant amyloid deposition and elevated peripheral inflammatory markers will
be the strongest predictors of memory decline and decline in AD-signature cortical thickness over a one year
period.

Predictors
peripheral levels of inflammation
amyloid deposition
interaction between the two

Outcomes
memory decline
decline in AD-signature cortical thickness
